paragraphs: SwiftGov is presented as an AI-native operating system for local government, built to strengthen permit and plan review, compliance, knowledge, data, and service delivery. The platform automates intake processing, flags potential code conflicts before they become resubmittals, and standardizes reviewer comments. The products listed for the Hernando County engagement are SwiftGov, Development Services Transformation, GIS Services, and Swift Analytics.

The jurisdictions named on the SwiftGov page are Hernando County, Pasco County, Clay County, Walton County, City of Jacksonville, City of Titusville, and Hernando County Clerk of Court, all in Florida. The case studies page describes municipal development services teams using SwiftGov for regulatory review. The case study ties the deployment to the rebuild surge after Hurricane Helene and Hurricane Milton in 2024.

Initial plan review time at Hernando County is reported as 30 days to 15 minutes, a 93% reduction in single-family home zoning review times. The county estimates direct net savings of $1.5 million annually across four primary areas, including reduced reliance on temporary staff and third-party plan review.

quote.text: SwiftGov doesn't replace plan reviewers. It amplifies them.
